typography.body: Inter, generous line height for readability

layout_and_spacing.padding: Generous spacing. Use 16px (p-4) to 24px (p-6) for screen containers and card internals.
layout_and_spacing.touch_targets: Minimum 44pt (44px) height/width for all buttons and interactive touchables (mobile-first accessibility).
layout_and_spacing.borders_and_radius: Cards should have subtle 1px borders and soft shadows. Use 8px-12px border radius for standard components, and fully rounded (9999px) for badges and avatars.

components.navigation: 5-tab bottom navigation (Dashboard, Contacts, Events, Invoices, Team). Separate Settings screen. Hidden /debug page accessible by 7-tapping the logo.
components.login: Centered card with water-drop logo, 'Internal sign-in only', email+password, large Sign In button, full-width outlined 'Create Admin Account' button. Below the card: a BLACK rounded box '🔧 Optimise phone for reliable reminders' which turns GREEN for 3 seconds when all permissions are granted, then disappears.
components.reminder_cards: Must feature a thick colored left border (green/yellow/red/grey) indicating status. Dense but clean data display.
components.activity_feed: List items annotated with specific icons: 🔔 (triggered), 💤 (snoozed), ✅ (ended), 👤 (delegated).
components.contacts_list: Include search, sort, colored initials avatars, and a Floating Action Button (FAB). Detail view has Call/WhatsApp/SMS/Email action buttons.
components.events: Filter tabs (Upcoming/Completed/Cancelled/All), filter by tag, by assignee. Event creation supports multiple reminders.
components.invoices: Tabs (Draft/Sent/Paid/Cancelled/All). PDF generation with specific header: org name in #1565C0, 'INVOICE', two-column block, alternating row items table with blue header, right-aligned totals, 'Errors & Omissions Excepted', signature box.
components.team_settings: Team member cards with avatar, name, role badge, permission toggles. Settings includes profile, password, ringtone, tags manager, products manager, DB connection, floating assistant toggle, Phone Optimisation panel.
components.alarm_takeover: Full-screen takeover Modal/View. Gradient background matching the event tag color. Large contact name, organization, tag badge, event time. Red END button, multi-option SNOOZE button, ASSIGN TO, and quick WhatsApp/Call/SMS actions. High contrast text.
components.dynamic_island: Pill-shaped absolute overlay positioned at top-center with 🔔 title, 💤 snooze, and ❌ end buttons.
components.floating_assistant: 52dp circular blue water-drop assistant bubble. Must be draggable and float above other content.
components.phone_optimization_panel: Reusable scannable component listing 6 items with green 'Done' or red 'Needs action' badges, 'Fix' buttons, and an overall progress bar.
components.debug_page: Contains session info, JWT decoder, DB test panel, storage inspector, and live log viewer.

media.logo: Use a vector icon (e.g., Lucide 'Droplet' or FontAwesome 'tint') colored in #1565C0 for the water-drop logo. Ensure it supports the 7-tap gesture.

testing.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `testID` (and `data-testid` where applicable) attribute (e.g., testID='login-submit-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a React Native Expo mobile app. Do NOT use HTML DOM elements (div, span). Use View, Text, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView, etc.
Apply styles using StyleSheet or NativeWind (Tailwind for React Native) to achieve the design system.
The ALARM UI must be an urgent, full-screen takeover. Use expo-linear-gradient for the background color based on the event tag.
The floating assistant requires react-native-gesture-handler and react-native-reanimated for draggable functionality.
Ensure the PDF generation strictly follows the invoice design requirements using expo-print or react-native-html-to-pdf.
Implement all colored badges, reminder borders, and activity icons exactly as specified.
